name: FLA_TAX_TRANSACTIONS
description: FLA_TAX_TRANSACTIONS contains the tax transaction details for the payment.

columns.name: TAX_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Payment tax transaction identifier. This is primary key for the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier from FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease details identifier which is referenced.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. Tax transactions are created for this Payment.

columns.name: REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the tax rate.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for which the rate is defined.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type. Possible values are RECOVERABLE and NONRECOVERABLE.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the Transaction date.

columns.name: COMMENCEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the commencement date.

columns.name: PRIOR_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Indicates the prior tax amount.

columns.name: FORECASTED_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Indicates the forecasted tax amount.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Indicates the adjusted tax amount.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate that the accounting is processed.

columns.name: REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the transaction is reversed or pending for reversal.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the tax transaction is active or not.

columns.name: REGENERATE_SCHEDULES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the schedules need to be regenerated.

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Contains parent tax transaction identifier.

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_ROU_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the amount is included in Right of Use or not.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating tax payment currency code.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Effective Tax rate which is calculated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment tax line number. This is generated by system using a document sequence.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Tax rate identifier of the selected tax rate code.

columns.name: RECOVERY_TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Recovery tax rate identifier of the selected recovery tax rate code.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for which this rate is defined.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
